Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject:  Audio Recording of Conference Call on Audited Financial Results (Consolidated and 
Standalone) for the year ended March 31, 2025 
 
In continuation of our letter dated May 07, 2025 and pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the 
conference call held on May 14, 2025, on the Audited Financial Results (Consolidated and 
Standalone) of the Company for the year ended 31st March, 2025, has been made available on the 
Company’s website at https://vipindustries.co.in/storage/recording-concalls/May2025/Concall-
V.I.P.INDUSTRIES%20LTD-14052025.mp3

Thanking you,
